presentation: Moderate hypothermia — non-arrest, core temperature 28 to 32 degrees, ataxia, slurred speech, shivering absent, cardiac monitoring mandatory
hint: Shivering stops below 30 degrees — its absence is a sign of severity not improvement. J waves on ECG are pathognomonic. Handle extremely gently — cold myocardium fibrillates with the slightest stimulation. Passive and active external rewarming. Warm humidified oxygen. Do not give cold IV fluids. Expected vitals: conscious but ataxic — GCS 12-14, never comatose; HR 40s-50s, RR 8-12, Temp 84-90F (report in Fahrenheit).
caller_behavior: healthcare worker on scene — nurse or EMT giving clinical handoff over phone
time_of_day: 2100 — night beginning, alcohol and recreational drug factor increasing
